notes: «حدثني أبي» names the father only by relation (relation kind); the co-transmitters of the first level meet at the next name («جميعا»).
«وكان في خدمة أبي جعفر الثاني (ع)» describes Yahya and is not a link; «عن علي» is written without a name, so the surface stays «علي».
The Imam sits inside the chain after «عن», so he is a narrator, not imam_in_text (owner ruling 2).
